t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The best way to get the most mushrooms is to alternate between gnomes until you work out which one gives the most mushrooms, if one colour of gnome was giving lots and is now only giving a few, try a different gnome.

vb_textbox.text: I think the colours are irrelevant, keep doing S until you get low numbers of mushrooms, then switch to K, and then back to S when the numbers drop again. It is impossible to know what the other gnome might have given you, if you had chosen it.
